purpose: Prove the universal Black-Ink engine across five deliberately different Tome I page types before mass production begins.

production_gate.rule: All five calibration pages must be human-approved with every required review dimension passing before mass Tome I generation may be treated as calibrated.

cases.calibration_role: small humanoid + trap storytelling + built dungeon perspective
stress_test: open pit clearly interrupts the corridor route
open coloring regions inside masonry scene
cases.special_rule: The open pit must visibly interrupt the walking route and read instantly as a trap; use only a few large readable spikes and keep the masonry simple.

cases.calibration_role: ooze volume + corridor scale + internal story objects
cases.special_rule: Internal objects must stay sparse and readable; the cube must remain enjoyable to color.

cases.calibration_role: object-monster identity + vault environment + close interaction
cases.special_rule: Use one reaching hand only as a subordinate story cue; it may not become a second focal subject.

cases.calibration_role: burrowing anatomy + natural earth environment + dynamic but supported emergence
cases.special_rule: Show the ankheg half-emerged with lower body visibly supported by the broken earth opening; never depict a midair jump or falling pose.

cases.calibration_role: unusual insectoid identity + material interaction + armory environment
cases.special_rule: Use only a few large ruined metal forms so the feeding beat reads without turning the armory into tiny-object homework.
